rule: Empirical failures admit product changes; passing discovery lanes do not manufacture work.

phases.evidence: Exact HM145 emitted safe-fresh with the previously selected verification path after that test file was changed, deleted, or renamed after sync.
Agent-start closing provenance fenced selected edit evidence/generation continuity but did not directly validate the selected verification file revision.
Added a bounded closing fence against the existing indexed verification file_digest; no second repository freshness registry or rescan was introduced.
Deletion now yields safe-stale with verification-changed-since-selection.
Rename now yields safe-stale with verification-changed-since-selection.
Content mutation now yields safe-stale even when the selected path still exists.
Regression mutates the selected verification file during edit evidence projection; the closing fence catches it before safe-fresh can escape.
Any selected verification file content change changes its canonical file digest, conservatively invalidating symbol-level selection without a second parse/search.
Fence is path/digest based and independent of tests/ naming; no root-specific authority was added.
Closing work hashes only the already-selected verification file; it does not sync, rescan, rerank, or re-index the repository.
Freshness defect does not justify changing selection ownership or retrieval.
No identity collision was required to reproduce the defect.
Existing indexed file_digest remains the comparison authority; no new persisted state is required.
Existing safe-stale and provenance freshness_reason semantics can represent the closure without a new packet schema.
Affected source ring passed 75/75 before packaging; exact-ZIP qualification and deterministic rebuild are promotion checks for this tranche.
